{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data to ensure we have the raw version
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check for the exact string '999999.99' in the revenue column
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of rows with revenue == '999999.99': {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check the actual raw values in the revenue column to see if any have commas
# We'll look for values that contain commas
comma_in_revenue = df['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)
print(f"Number of revenue values containing commas: {comma_in_revenue.sum()}")

# Show a few examples of revenue values that contain commas
print("Examples of revenue values with commas:")
print(df.loc[comma_in_revenue, 'revenue'].head())"}
